bibl.title: Michail Rostovcev e gli intellettuali italiani.
bibl.seg: Cinzia Cadamagnani, Michail Rostovcev e gli intellettuali italiani.
bibl.note: Reconstructs the relationship between the Russian historian Mikhail Rostovtzeff (1870-1952) and the Italian intellectuals of the first half of the twentieth century.
